contexts.text: (Why Israel was commanded to spoil the Egyptians.)
To snatch him that is spoiled from the hand of the oppressor () = to do the good of charity.
To devour the spoil () = to appropriate to Himself those whom He has delivered.
That to devour the spoil or spoil = to appropriate to himself goods which have been carried off by evils. Illustrated.
I will divide the spoil () = slavery. The spoil = those who have been subjugated; hence to divide the spoil = to distribute among themselves those who are reduced to slavery.
Spoiled = to be without goods; naked = to be without truths.
